content: Vector redesign round 2026-11-21: vector-config 0.1.0-r1 package (static config, replaces=vector takeover, GENERIC 1:1 source->file - one glob source one dedicated /var/log file; sources inert via ignore_not_found, no conditional blocks); vector-dinit 0.1.0-r9 (wrapper ensures the sink files vector-owned before exec); feralos.json.log REMOVED (owner decision, per-source files only); debug vector API REMOVED; security-stack vector sources REMOVED (native persistent files; conf.d drop-ins for shipping later); logrotate GENERIC (/var/log/*.log + /*/*.log one rule); login_readiness PASSIVE autologin measurement via kernel timestamps (autologin total 4.00s baseline, real-machine 5-min slowdown now measurable); wayle-session r11 session log to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR tailed by vector into /var/log/user-session.log; run32 130/130 ALL GREEN. Ground truths: vector 0.55 interpolates env vars in RAW config text including COMMENTS (exit 78 when unset); fail2ban races vector for auth.log (wrapper pre-creates it vector-owned); typed-login flow DELETED (boot-storm greeter cycle rejects keyboard input 30-75s, measured); Harness autologin RESTORED for niri family. Deferred: feralos-localed provider (backlog), log-notify standalone repo (spec + research in artifacts).

Vector redesign round 2026-11-15/21: vector-config 0.1.0-r1 package (static config, replaces=vector takeover of the Alpine demo, GENERIC 1:1 source->file pattern - one glob source one dedicated /var/log file; sources inert via ignore_not_found, no conditional blocks); vector-dinit 0.1.0-r9 (wrapper ensures the sink files vector:vector before exec - the boot-storm input window rejected the typed login AND fail2ban raced vector for auth.log, both fixed by pre-created/pre-chowned files); feralos.json.log REMOVED (owner decision, per-source files only); debug vector API REMOVED; security-stack vector sources REMOVED (native persistent files; conf.d drop-ins for shipping later); logrotate GENERIC (/var/log/*.log + /*/*.log one uniform rule, new logs auto-covered); login_readiness PASSIVE autologin measurement via kernel timestamps (baseline 4.00s total on QEMU; the real-machine 5-min slowdown is now measurable against this baseline); wayle-session r11 session log to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR tailed by vector into /var/log/user-session.log; font parity niriWayle (font-noto base + niri-portalsconf added). Ground truths: vector 0.55 interpolates env vars in RAW config text INCLUDING COMMENTS (exit 78 when unset - no export handling in the shell parser either, export lines kill the whole parse); typed-login flow DELETED (greeter cycles during the boot storm reject keyboard input 30-75s, measured with debug_run); Harness test autologin RESTORED for the niri family (passive measurement needs it). Deferred: feralos-localed provider (backlog - openrc-settingsd exists in Alpine community and is the reference to copy-improve), log-notify standalone repo (spec written). CI note: CHANGELOG-shape gate ([Unreleased] before dated entries) only runs on remote CI, not pre-commit.

ADR-013 R1 round closed: vector-config r3 ships remote-shipping instructions in conf.d README (docs only); log_errors made retry-aware (retriedAttempt + unit test); harness 131/131 green on btrfsStandard+niriWayle with 32G default; aports pushed from the in-repo aports/ working copy.

Desktop matrix all green: niriWayle 132/132, niri 129/129, KDE 90/90, COSMIC 90/90. Fixed login_readiness DE-awareness and the alsa-utils-dinit conversion noise. ADR-013 config packages verified live everywhere.

OpenRC 107/107 and dinit 133/133 green. Fixed: busybox syslogd hijacking vector's /dev/log (neuter takeover), vendor initd logfile on root-owned /var/log (pre-create), dbus-audit OpenRC exit (PID1 comm + tag release flow), log_errors allowlist gaps. vector-setup-openrc is the only OpenRC workaround; vector-config = configs+sinks only; vector-dinit = service only; /btrbk out of vector.
